object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In VCU3-SRS, set VCU3-SRS-2's description from the grid to three lines, with an empty line between two paragraphs. Expected: the object file and the grid cell hold the whole text. Set it to one line, then to five lines. Expected: the row is taller with five lines. Give VCU3-SRS-15 twelve lines. Expected: its row grows and the next row keeps its height. Narrow the description column step by step. Expected: once the resizing stops, the rows grow to fit the wrapped text.
